name: common-scents-root
description: Root package for Common Scents application.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=4096' npm run build
scripts.build:all: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.preview: npm run build:all && concurrently "npm run preview:frontend" "npm run preview:backend"
